blocks.text: That is a welcome way to close the question, and our thanks go to whoever on your team ran the new extract so quickly. I have marked the duplicated records as closed in our request log, with a note that the original file was replaced rather than adjusted, so there is a clear trail if anyone later asks how the reserve detail for {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} came to agree with the year-end figures.

As David says, the checks on the individual fields come next, and he expects to start on them tomorrow. If they turn up anything that needs your team's knowledge of the records, it will reach you from me, the same way as before, along with a note of what we would assume in the meantime, so that you are never left wondering what we have done with a record.

That leaves one item open from our original request: the documentation of the methods and assumptions behind the current reserves, including any change made during the year. Jennifer can begin her part of the review as soon as it arrives, so it is the thing we would most like to have from you next.
